content_groups.group_title: Q: What would make you suspect multiple pregnancy?

blocks.text: A uterus larger than expected for gestational age, multiple fetal poles, multiple presenting parts or difficulty identifying a single fetal pole. Ultrasound confirms the diagnosis.

content_groups.group_title: Q: What would you do if you suspected fetal growth restriction?

blocks.text: Review gestational dating and previous fundal-height measurements, assess fetal wellbeing and arrange ultrasound assessment of fetal growth, amniotic fluid and Doppler studies as appropriate.
